description.value: The Black Sheep Public House is a long-established Maple Ridge neighbourhood pub operating since 1987, voted best pub in the Maple Ridge and Ridge Meadows area. Seating over 200 guests, it offers an extensive food menu with daily specials and over 18 beers on tap. The venue is located minutes from Golden Ears Provincial Park and also operates an adjacent liquor store — the largest in the city by its own account.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at theblacksheeppub.ca is fully accessible and confirms an active, long-established pub at 12968 232nd Street, Maple Ridge BC V2X 6V2, with regular events running into 2024-2025 and a full food menu. The phone number 604.476.1008 is confirmed from the website footer and contact page but was absent from OSM tags. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, takeout) are explicitly mentioned anywhere on the site, though the menu labels vegetarian dishes with '(V)', confirming vegetarian options are available.
concerns: Phone number 604.476.1008 confirmed on website but absent from OSM tags — OSM record should be updated.
Liquor store subpage contains a COVID-19 notice that appears to be outdated, though active 2024/2025 pub events confirm the business is currently operating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, fully operational pub with confirmed address, extensive website content, and 2024-2025 events — a useful food and drink stop for cyclists, especially those heading to or from Golden Ears Provincial Park.
enrichment_extras.notes: The pub is explicitly described as minutes from Golden Ears Provincial Park, making it a practical stop for cyclists on park-adjacent routes. The adjacent Black Sheep Liquor Store is open daily and may be useful for resupply.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks vegetarian items with '(V)', including Spinach & Artichoke Dip, Yam Fries, and Tzatziki Dip
